requirements.text: CDN peering allows different CDN providers to share resources in order to provide larger scale and/or reach to each participant than they could not achieve otherwise.
requirements.source_sentence: CDN peering allows different CDN providers to share resources in order to provide larger scale and/or reach to each participant than they could not achieve otherwise.

requirements.text: CDN peering is formed by a set of autonomous CDNs that cooperate through a mechanism providing facilities and infrastructure for cooperation in order to virtualize multiple providers.
requirements.source_sentence: It is formed by a set of autonomous CDNs, which cooperate through a mechanism that provides facilities and infrastructure for cooperation in order to virtualize multiple providers.

requirements.text: An effective peering arrangement between CDNs requires multiple steps to occur.
conditions: an effective peering arrangement exists or is being established
requirements.source_sentence: It is expected that an effective peering arrangement between CDNs would require multiple steps to occur.

requirements.text: A CDN’s reach and scale is limited by its ability to handle peak load, cost of equipment, scalable infrastructure, and demand for increased coverage.
conditions: reach and scale are constrained by peak load handling, equipment cost, scalable infrastructure, and coverage demand
requirements.source_sentence: A CDN’s reach and scale is limited by its ability to handle peak load, cost of equipment, scalable infrastructure, and/or demand for the increased coverage of its infrastructure.

requirements.text: Peering allows a particular CDN to achieve larger scale and reach through resource sharing with other CDN(s).
requirements.source_sentence: Peering allows a particular CDN to achieve larger scale/reach through resource sharing with other CDN(s).

requirements.text: Peering is triggered by an initialization request sent to the mediator under exceptional circumstances.
actions: send initialization request to the mediator
requirements.source_sentence: It is triggered by an initialization request sent to the mediator under exceptional circumstances, e.g. flash crowds, when the (primary) CDN realizes that it cannot handle a part of the workload on its Web Servers (WSs).

requirements.text: Flash crowds are an example of exceptional circumstances that can trigger peering when the primary CDN cannot handle part of the workload on its Web Servers.
conditions: the primary CDN cannot handle part of the workload on its Web Servers
requirements.source_sentence: It is triggered by an initialization request sent to the mediator under exceptional circumstances, e.g. flash crowds, when the (primary) CDN realizes that it cannot handle a part of the workload on its Web Servers (WSs).

requirements.text: The triggering condition must consider expected and unexpected load increases in the initiating CDN.
requirements.source_sentence: The triggering condition must consider the expected and unexpected load increases in the initiating CDN.

requirements.text: The controlling interest of a CDN to interconnect with other CDNs leads to the creation of a negotiated relationship.
requirements.source_sentence: The controlling interest of a CDN to interconnect with other CDNs leads to the creation of a negotiated relationship.

requirements.text: The negotiated relationship takes the form of a legal document describing expected service levels and preconditions.
requirements.source_sentence: In the business domain, this relationship (most likely) would take the form of a legal document which describes the expected level of services from the involving parties such as storage requirements, the required rate of transfer, cost of services; the expected duration of receiving service, penalties for service violations, and other preconditions such as the initiating CDN’s preference to gain resources at a particular region.

requirements.text: The negotiated relationship specifies storage requirements, transfer rate, cost of services, expected service duration, penalties for service violations, and region preference.
requirements.source_sentence: In the business domain, this relationship (most likely) would take the form of a legal document which describes the expected level of services from the involving parties such as storage requirements, the required rate of transfer, cost of services; the expected duration of receiving service, penalties for service violations, and other preconditions such as the initiating CDN’s preference to gain resources at a particular region.

requirements.text: Negotiated relationships can be established through financial statements or through SLAs.
conditions: financial statement terms are used or SLA terms are used
requirements.source_sentence: Negotiated relationships can also be established through means non-technical terms (financial statement) or technical terms (SLAs).

requirements.text: Negotiated relationships must specify interactions among entities including service administration, coordination, and disband or re-arrangement of internetworked CDNs.
requirements.source_sentence: Thus, negotiated relationships must specify the interactions among entities including service administration, coordination and disband (or re-arrangement) of internetworked CDNs.

requirements.text: In the CDN peering architecture, the mediator instance obtains resource and access information from the Service Registry and SLAs and other policies from the Policy Repository.
requirements.source_sentence: In the CDN peering architecture, the mediator instance obtains the resource and access information from the Service Registry (SR), whilst SLAs and other policies from the Policy Repository (PR).

requirements.text: The mediator instance on the primary CDN’s behalf generates service requirements based on the current circumstance and SLA requirements of its customer(s).
conditions: current circumstance and customer SLA requirements exist
requirements.source_sentence: The mediator instance on the primary CDN’s behalf generates its service requirements based on the current circumstance and SLA requirements of its customer(s).

requirements.text: Divergent policies are allowed to specify what information can be shared during interaction by providing a certain level of visibility to preserve privacy.
requirements.source_sentence: Therefore, divergent policies are allowed that specify the information that can be shared during interaction through providing a certain level of visibility to preserve privacy.

requirements.text: Once the initiating CDN identifies its roles and activities through the created negotiated relationships, the next step is to choose potential CDNs to peer with.
requirements.source_sentence: Once the initiating CDN identifies its roles and activities through the created negotiated relationships for coordination and cooperation between CDNs, the next step is to choose potential CDNs to peer with.

requirements.text: The mediator instance passes the service requirements to the local PA to discover external resources from peers.
requirements.source_sentence: The mediator instance passes the service requirements to the local PA to discover external resources from peers.

requirements.text: The PA performs the resource discovery process by predicting peer performance and working around separate administration and limited information sharing among enlisted CDNs.
requirements.source_sentence: The PA performs the resource discovery process through predicting performance of the peers, working around issues of separate administration and limited information sharing among enlisted CDNs.

requirements.text: If preexisting peering arrangements exist in a long-term scenario, those arrangements are returned.
requirements.source_sentence: If there are any preexisting peering arrangements (for a long term scenario) then these will be returned at this point.

requirements.text: Otherwise, the PA carries out short-term negotiations with identified peering targets.
requirements.source_sentence: Otherwise, it carries out short term negotiations with the Peering Agent (PA) identified peering targets.

requirements.text: CDN peering protocols are configured at the conduit of the respective CDNs to technically support the negotiated terms and policies.
requirements.source_sentence: The next step is to configure the ‘CDN peering’ protocols at the conduit of the respective CDNs in order to technically support the terms and policies implicitly specified through the negotiated relationships.

requirements.text: The configuration step includes advertising topology aspects, geographical proximity, capability, and performance of enlisted CDNs through inter-PA communication.
requirements.source_sentence: This step includes advertising the configurations (topology aspects, geographical proximity, capability, performance, etc.) of enlisted CDNs through inter-PA communication.

requirements.text: After a peering arrangement is established, participating CDNs exchange content availability information and request redirection is enabled to an optimal peer.
requirements.source_sentence: On establishment of a peering arrangement, these protocols also allow participating CDNs to exchange information regarding the content availability and assists to redirect requests to an optimal peer.

requirements.text: Request redirection depends on content distribution and request-routing policies, as well as the algorithms and methods used for directing requests.
conditions: algorithms and methods for directing requests apply
requirements.source_sentence: Request-redirection in a peering arrangement depends on the content distribution and request-routing policies (specified in the CDN peering protocols) associated with the content as well as the specific algorithms and methods used for directing these requests.

requirements.text: When the primary CDN acquires sufficient resources from the peers to meet its SLA, the peering arrangement becomes operational.
conditions: the primary CDN meets its SLA
requirements.source_sentence: When the primary CDN acquires sufficient resources from the peers to meet its SLA with the customer, the new peering arrangement becomes operational.

requirements.text: Necessary functional policies are deployed and administered effectively once the peering arrangement becomes operational.
requirements.source_sentence: Hence, necessary functional policies are deployed and administered in an effective way.

requirements.text: Once a peering arrangement is established, all participating parties cooperate in the execution of common goals.
requirements.source_sentence: Once a peering arrangement is established, all participating parties cooperate in the execution of common goal(s).

requirements.text: Peering enables the CDNs to exchange accounting information for billing based on the negotiated relationships.
requirements.source_sentence: Peering also enables the CDNs to exchange accounting information to perform billing based on the negotiated relationships.

requirements.text: If no CDN is interested in peering, peering arrangement creation through re-negotiation is resumed by tuning the negotiated relationships with reconsidered service requirements.
actions: resume peering arrangement creation through re-negotiation
conditions: no CDN is interested in peering
requirements.source_sentence: If no CDN is interested in such peering, peering arrangement creation through re-negotiation is resumed by tuning the negotiated relationships with reconsidered service requirements.

requirements.text: An existing peering arrangement may need to disband or re-arrange itself if the original formation circumstances no longer hold.
conditions: the circumstances under which the arrangement was formed no longer hold
requirements.source_sentence: An existing peering arrangement may need to either disband or re-arrange itself (within the scope of the negotiated relationships) if any of the following conditions hold: (a) the circumstances under which the arrangement was formed no longer hold; (b) peering is no longer beneficial for the participating CDNs; (c) an existing peering arrangement needs to be expanded further in order to deal with additional load; or (d) participating CDNs are not meeting their agreed upon contributions.

requirements.text: An existing peering arrangement may need to disband or re-arrange itself if peering is no longer beneficial for the participating CDNs.
conditions: peering is no longer beneficial for the participating CDNs
requirements.source_sentence: An existing peering arrangement may need to either disband or re-arrange itself (within the scope of the negotiated relationships) if any of the following conditions hold: (a) the circumstances under which the arrangement was formed no longer hold; (b) peering is no longer beneficial for the participating CDNs; (c) an existing peering arrangement needs to be expanded further in order to deal with additional load; or (d) participating CDNs are not meeting their agreed upon contributions.

requirements.text: An existing peering arrangement may need to disband or re-arrange itself if it needs to be expanded further to deal with additional load.
conditions: the arrangement needs expansion for additional load
requirements.source_sentence: An existing peering arrangement may need to either disband or re-arrange itself (within the scope of the negotiated relationships) if any of the following conditions hold: (a) the circumstances under which the arrangement was formed no longer hold; (b) peering is no longer beneficial for the participating CDNs; (c) an existing peering arrangement needs to be expanded further in order to deal with additional load; or (d) participating CDNs are not meeting their agreed upon contributions.

requirements.text: An existing peering arrangement may need to disband or re-arrange itself if participating CDNs are not meeting their agreed upon contributions.
conditions: participating CDNs are not meeting their agreed upon contributions
requirements.source_sentence: An existing peering arrangement may need to either disband or re-arrange itself (within the scope of the negotiated relationships) if any of the following conditions hold: (a) the circumstances under which the arrangement was formed no longer hold; (b) peering is no longer beneficial for the participating CDNs; (c) an existing peering arrangement needs to be expanded further in order to deal with additional load; or (d) participating CDNs are not meeting their agreed upon contributions.

requirements.text: A Web server replicates content on-demand from the origin server and stores it for future use.
requirements.source_sentence: A Web server replicates content on-demand from the origin server and stores it for future use.

requirements.text: In the event of a Web hotspot, a Web server initiates a request to trigger peering.
requirements.source_sentence: In the event of Web hotspot, it initiates request to trigger peering.

requirements.text: The Web services host ensures delivery of content to end-users based on negotiated policies with other CDNs.
conditions: negotiated policies with other CDNs exist
requirements.source_sentence: The Web services host ensures the delivery of content to end-users based on the negotiated policies with other CDNs.

requirements.text: The policy agent, in conjunction with the mediator, determines which resources can be delegated and under what conditions delegation is permitted.
requirements.source_sentence: The policy agent is responsible (in conjunction with the mediator) for determining which resources can be delegated and under what conditions (policies) delegation is permitted.

requirements.text: The SLA-allocator provisions and reserves Web server resources to satisfy local and delegated SLAs and ensures that SLA terms are enforced.
requirements.source_sentence: The SLA-allocator performs the provisioning and reservation of Web server’s resources (e.g. CPU, bandwidth, storage etc.) to satisfy both local and delegated SLAs, and ensures that the terms of the SLAs are enforced.

requirements.text: The Web servers’ underlying algorithms perform on-demand caching, content selection, and routing between servers.
requirements.source_sentence: The Web servers’ underlying algorithms perform on-demand caching, content selection, and routing between servers.

requirements.text: The Mediator generates service requirements as the basis for negotiated relationships.
requirements.source_sentence: It generates service requirements as the basis for negotiated relationships.

requirements.text: The Mediator passes the service requirements to the PA.
requirements.source_sentence: It passes the service requirements to the PA.

requirements.text: The Mediator works in conjunction with its local PA to discover external resources and to negotiate with other CDNs.
requirements.source_sentence: It works in conjunction with its local PA to discover external resources and to negotiate with other CDNs.

requirements.text: Once a peering arrangement is established, the Mediator controls what portion of Web traffic is redirected to peering CDN Web servers, which content is replicated there, how replication decisions are taken, and which replication policies are used.
requirements.source_sentence: Once a peering arrangement is established, it controls what portion of the Web traffic (i.e. end-user requests) is redirected to the Web servers of the peering CDNs, which content is replicated there, how the replication decision is taken, and which replication policies are being used.

requirements.text: The Mediator ensures that participating entities can adapt to changing circumstances and achieve their objectives in a dynamic and uncertain environment.
conditions: a dynamic and uncertain environment exists
requirements.source_sentence: It ensures that the participating entities are able to adapt to changing circumstances (agility) and are able to achieve their objectives in a dynamic and uncertain environment (resilience)

requirements.text: The Service Registry encapsulates the resource and service information for each CDN.
requirements.source_sentence: It encapsulates the resource and service information for each CDN.

requirements.text: The Service Registry helps discover local resources by enabling Web servers of CDN providers to register and publish their resource, service, and policy details.
requirements.source_sentence: It helps in discovering local resources through enabling the Web servers of CDN providers to register and publish their resource, service and policy details.

requirements.text: In traffic surges, the Service Registry supplies necessary local resource information to the mediator.
requirements.source_sentence: In the face of traffic surges, it supplies any necessary local resource information to the mediator.

requirements.text: When a new peering arrangement is established, a Service Registry instance is created that encapsulates all local and delegated external CDN resources.
conditions: a new peering arrangement is established
requirements.source_sentence: When a new peering arrangement is established, an instance of the service registry is created that encapsulates all local and delegated external CDN resources.

requirements.text: The Policy Repository virtualizes all policies within a peering arrangement, including Web server-specific policies, mediator policies, peering policies, and delegated policies for resources.
requirements.source_sentence: It virtualizes all of the policies within a peering arrangement including PWS, P M , and P Peering (i.e. Web server-specific policies, mediator policies, peering policies), along with any delegated policies for resources as a result of the peering arrangement.

requirements.text: The Policy Repository provides rules to the mediator to administer, manage, and control access to resources in a peering arrangement.
requirements.source_sentence: It provides a set of rules to the mediator to administer, manage, and control access to the resources in a peering arrangement.

requirements.text: The Policy Repository returns existing peering policies to the PA during establishment of long-term peering arrangements.
conditions: long-term peering arrangements are being established
requirements.source_sentence: It returns existing peering policies to the PA during the establishment of long-term peering arrangements.

requirements.text: A Peering Agent acts as a policy-driven resource discovery module for establishing negotiations.
actions: act as a resource discovery module
requirements.source_sentence: It acts as a policy-driven resource discovery module for establishing negotiations.

requirements.text: A Peering Agent exchanges policy, resource information, and service requirements with external PAs.
requirements.source_sentence: It exchanges policy, resource information, and service requirements with external PAs.

requirements.text: A Peering Agent is used as a conduit by the mediator to establish negotiations with PAs of other peers and to acquire resources from them.
requirements.source_sentence: It is used as a conduit by the mediator to establish negotiations with PAs of other peers and to acquire resources from them.

requirements.text: The components of CDN peering are driven by semi-autonomous logic that ensures content is served reliably through content replication, request-routing, and redirection while maintaining constant awareness of participant health.
requirements.source_sentence: The operations performed by the components of the CDN peering is driven by semi-autonomous logic that ensures content is served reliably through content replication, request-routing and redirection whilst maintaining constant awareness of the health (e.g. load information) of participants.

requirements.text: Content replication is performed using a cooperative pull-based approach where participating CDNs assist each other in serving data.
actions: assist each other in serving data
requirements.source_sentence: Content replication is performed using a cooperative pull-based approach where participating CDNs assist each others in serving data.

requirements.text: Content replication extends content to participating servers from peers in a peering arrangement subject to the resources they contribute.
requirements.source_sentence: Thus, content replication is featured through extending it to participating servers from the peers in a given peering arrangement, subject to the available resources they contribute.

requirements.text: Load distribution is performed by measuring load information and disseminating it within individual CDNs and among other CDNs using a hierarchical approach.
requirements.source_sentence: Load distribution is performed by measuring the load information and disseminating it within individual CDNs and amongst other CDNs using a hierarchical approach, where current bandwidth and resource usage of web servers in a CDN is reported to the CDN gateway (i.e. mediator, PA and policy repository as a single conceptual entity) in a periodic or threshold-based manner.

requirements.text: Current bandwidth and resource usage of Web servers in a CDN is reported to the CDN gateway in a periodic or threshold-based manner.
conditions: periodic reporting or threshold-based reporting applies
requirements.source_sentence: Load distribution is performed by measuring the load information and disseminating it within individual CDNs and amongst other CDNs using a hierarchical approach, where current bandwidth and resource usage of web servers in a CDN is reported to the CDN gateway (i.e. mediator, PA and policy repository as a single conceptual entity) in a periodic or threshold-based manner.

requirements.text: The gateways of participating CDNs communicate aggregated load information describing the load of their constituent servers.
requirements.source_sentence: The gateways of participating CDNs then communicate aggregated load information describing the load of their constituent servers.

requirements.text: Request assignment and redirection is performed at the DNS level, at gateways to local clusters, and between servers in a cluster.
requirements.source_sentence: Request assignment and redirection is performed at multiple levels – at the DNS, at the gateways to local clusters, and also (redirection) between servers in a cluster.

requirements.text: End-users can be assigned via DNS by peering agents regularly updating DNS records and via redirection at the CDN gateway when appropriate.
requirements.source_sentence: Therefore, end-users can be assigned via DNS (by the peering agents of participating CDNs updating their DNS records regularly) and also via redirection at the CDN gateway when appropriate.
